raw_graphql_pull_request.body: ## Motivation SGLang Diffusion has no native Stable Diffusion XL support; `stabilityai/stable-diffusion-xl-base-1.0` only runs through the generic `--backend diffusers` path. This PR adds a native SDXL text-to-image pipeline, validated on Intel Arc Pro B60 (XPU) and NVIDIA A100 (CUDA). The implementation reuses existing SGLang components rather than adding a standalone UNet: the native SD UNet already used by Hunyuan3D, the CLIP encoders and CLIP handling from SD3, `AutoencoderKL` with the existing `StableDiffusionVAEConfig`, and the standard timestep / latent / denoising / decoding stages. No new pipeline stage is added. ## Modifications - **Shared UNet** (`dits/stable_diffusion.py`): `StableDiffusionUNet2DConditionModel` gains a per-level transformer depth (`transformer_layers_per_block`, e.g. `[1, 2, 10]`) and the SDXL `text_time` add-embedding (pooled text embeds + size/crop ids). Defaults are unchanged, so Hunyuan3D's module tree and state dict are identical; its validation is untouched apart from an early return for the SDXL block layout. - **SDXL denoiser** (`dits/stable_diffusion_xl.py`, new): a thin `CachableDiT` holding the shared UNet (same composition as `Hunyuan3DPaintUNet`). `_aliases = ["UNet2DConditionModel"]` maps the checkpoint's `unet/config.json` class to it; a `unet.` prefix rule maps Diffusers weight names. - **Scheduler** (`scheduling_euler_discrete.py`, new): `EulerDiscreteScheduler` wrapper delegating to Diffusers, following the existing DPM-Solver wrapper. - **Configs**: SDXL DiT, sampling, and pipeline configs. The pipeline config subclasses the SD3 config to reuse its CLIP tokenization and penultimate-layer features. It concatenates the two encoders' embeddings (768 + 1280 = 2048), takes the pooled output from `text_encoder_2`, builds `time_ids`, and zeroes negative embeddings for an empty negative prompt (Diffusers' `force_zeros_for_empty_prompt`). - **Pipeline** (`pipelines/stable_diffusion_xl.py`, new): standard stages only, with the denoiser under the `unet` key. - **Loader**: `TransformerLoader` accepts the `unet` component. - **CI**: an XPU-only server case `sdxl_base_image_t2i` in `gpu_cases.py` (added to `ONE_GPU_XPU_CASE_IDS`) plus its `xpu_b60.json` perf baseline. It is registered only on XPU because no CUDA baseline or consistency GT exists for it; consistency and component-accuracy checks are off, with UNet parity covered by the unit test below. - **Docs**: SDXL cookbook page (B60 and A100 recipes and benchmarks), supported-model catalog entry, sidebar entry, and a Stability AI card on the diffusion overview (logo from Stability AI's Hugging Face org avatar). ## Accuracy Tests **Unit test** (CPU): a tiny SDXL-layout config with `text_time` and per-level depths `(1, 2, 3)`, run through the new denoiser's `forward`, matches Diffusers' `UNet2DConditionModel` at `rtol=atol=1e-5` with a strict state-dict load. The existing Hunyuan3D SD2.1 parity and paint tests still pass. **End-to-end on XPU** (1x Arc Pro B60 and 1x A100): 1024x1024, 30 steps, guidance 7.5, seed 42, prompt "a beautiful sunset over the ocean, photorealistic". SGLang and the reference start from identical latents. The reference is Diffusers' `StableDiffusionXLPipeline` in full fp32; the VAE is fp32 in all runs. | UNet | Text encoders | B60 PSNR / SSIM | A100 PSNR / SSIM | |---|---|---|---| | fp32 | fp32 | 51.14 dB / 0.9974 | 46.25 dB / 0.9928 | | bf16 (default) | fp16 (default) | 37.92 dB / 0.9648 | 27.02 dB / 0.8571 | | bf16 | fp32 | 37.53 dB / 0.9630 | 23.50 dB / 0.7842 | | bf16 | bf16 | 36.10 dB / 0.9528 | 35.33 dB / 0.9523 | - The fp32 rows show SGLang reproduces Diffusers on both platforms. - The lower bf16 scores on the A100 are bf16 drift, not an SGLang difference: Diffusers' own bf16 UNet with fp32 text encoders scores **23.49 dB / 0.7843** against the same fp32 reference, matching SGLang's 23.50 dB / 0.7842. Re-running the A100 bf16 configs with `--allow-cudnn-tf32 false --allow-bf16-reduced-precision-reduction false` gave identical scores. - With one prompt and seed, which bf16 configuration lands closest to fp32 varies, so the bf16 rows should not be ranked against each other. ## Output images | Platform | Pipeline (UNet / text encoders) | PSNR / SSIM | Output | |---|---|---|---| | B60 | Diffusers fp32 reference | - | | | B60 | SGLang fp32 / fp32 | 51.14 dB / 0.9974 | | | B60 | SGLang bf16 / fp16 (default) | 37.92 dB / 0.9648 | | | A100 | Diffusers fp32 reference | - | | | A100 | SGLang fp32 / fp32 | 46.25 dB / 0.9928 | | | A100 | SGLang bf16 / fp16 (default) | 27.02 dB / 0.8571 | | ## Speed Tests and Profiling Single cold `sglang generate` requests at 1024x1024 with `--num-inference-steps 30 --guidance-scale 7.5 --seed 42` (fresh process per run, so end-to-end includes one-time costs), same workload as above: | Config | B60 per step | B60 end-to-end | A100 per step | A100 end-to-end | |---|---|---|---|---| | fp32 UNet / fp32 text encoders | 1.623 s | 53.15 s | 0.377 s | 28.93 s | | bf16 UNet / fp16 text encoders (default) | 0.157 s | 14.14 s | 0.145 s | 6.41 s | | Diffusers fp32 reference | - | 50.96 s | - | 7.93 s | Hardware/software: Intel Arc Pro B60 24GB, PyTorch 2.13 XPU, Diffusers 0.38.0; NVIDIA A100-SXM4-40GB, PyTorch 2.14.1 CUDA 13.0, Diffusers 0.37.0. XPU CI case `sdxl_base_image_t2i` (50 steps, `SGLANG_DIFFUSION_SYNC_STAGE_PROFILING=1`, as for the existing XPU baselines, measured after one 1024x1024 server warmup request): 309.8 ms per step, 16.9 s end to end; it passes against the new baseline. This PR is about functional support; performance work is planned as follow-ups: - Attention calls `F.scaled_dot_product_attention` directly; routing it through SGLang's attention layer (XPU flash attention) and adding TP linears comes next. - Cold single-request `sglang generate` runs (no warmup) report large VAE decode times in some configurations (about 6.5 s on the B60 with a bf16 UNet, 13.6 s on the A100 with an fp32 UNet). The XPU CI request decodes in 1.3 s, but it runs after a 1024x1024 server warmup request and with `SGLANG_DIFFUSION_SYNC_STAGE_PROFILING=1`, so the gap is likely one-time first-request cost, possibly plus unsynchronized GPU work attributed to decode. Steady-state, stage-synchronized measurement on both platforms will confirm whether any per-request decode cost remains. Reproduce: ```bash sglang generate --model-path stabilityai/stable-diffusion-xl-base-1.0 \ --prompt "a beautiful sunset over the ocean, photorealistic" \ --height 1024 --width 1024 --num-inference-steps 30 --guidance-scale 7.5 --seed 42 \ --save-output ``` Notes for reviewers: - On a cold HF cache the XPU CI case downloads 62 GB, because the default download filter only skips `*.onnx` / `*.msgpack` and the SDXL repo also ships OpenVINO exports, ONNX weight data, and single-file checkpoints. A per-model download filter is left for a follow-up. - CUDA CI coverage is left for a follow-up: the case is XPU-only, and enabling it on CUDA needs an H100-measured `h100.json` entry (A100 numbers would not be comparable) plus a consistency GT image or `run_consistency_check=False`. - Not in this PR: LoRA (the LoRA pipeline targets `transformer`), the refiner (`stabilityai/stable-diffusion-xl-refiner-1.0`), image-to-image with these weights (Diffusers' `StableDiffusionXLImg2ImgPipeline`), and multi-GPU parallelism. ## Checklist - [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit). - [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests). - [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). - [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). - [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance). ## Review and Merge Process 1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process). 2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers. 3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so. - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci` 4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR. --- ### CI States Latest PR Test (Base): :x: [Run #39113716510](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39113716510) Latest PR Test (Extra): :x: [Run #39113716475](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39113716475) Latest PR Test (AMD ROCm 10): :x: [Run #39113716467](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39113716467)

Quick start + +Follow the [SGLang Diffusion installation guide](/docs/sglang-diffusion/installation) for your GPU platform; on Intel GPUs, also follow the [Intel XPU setup](/docs/hardware-platforms/xpu). Then generate the serve command below. + + + +## 2. Model capabilities + +[Stable Diffusion XL base 1.0](https://huggingface.co/stabilityai/stable-diffusion-xl-base-1.0) is Stability AI's latent-diffusion text-to-image model. A 2.6B-parameter UNet conditions on two text encoders, CLIP ViT-L and OpenCLIP ViT-bigG, and generates 1024x1024 images natively. It also conditions on the original image size and crop coordinates, which SDXL uses to reduce cropping artifacts. + +Choose it when you need a widely adopted open-weight image model with a small footprint: the full pipeline fits on one 24GB GPU. It is a classifier-free-guidance model that runs about 30 to 50 denoising steps, so it is slower per image than distilled models such as Z-Image-Turbo. SGLang serves the base model only; the refiner stage is not supported. + +## 3. Deployment details + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + +
CheckpointBest fitBoundary
`stabilityai/stable-diffusion-xl-base-1.0`Text-to-image at 1024x1024Base model only; no refiner, LoRA, or multi-GPU parallelism yet
+ +The model is released under the [CreativeML Open RAIL++-M License](https://huggingface.co/stabilityai/stable-diffusion-xl-base-1.0/blob/main/LICENSE.md). + +SGLang runs the UNet in bf16, the text encoders in fp16, and the VAE in fp32 by default. The SDXL VAE overflows in fp16, so keep it in fp32. SGLang's automatic memory policy chooses where the smaller components live: on the 24GB Arc Pro B60 it keeps the text encoders in host memory, and on a 40GB A100 it streams the text encoders and VAE layer by layer from pinned host memory. The UNet stays on the GPU in both cases. + +You can override component precision at startup with `--dit-precision`, `--text-encoder-precisions`, and `--vae-precision`. The bf16 UNet runs about 10x faster than fp32 on the Arc Pro B60 and about 2.6x faster on the A100 (see [Benchmark](#5-benchmark)). + +An empty negative prompt produces zero negative embeddings, matching the Diffusers default for SDXL base (`force_zeros_for_empty_prompt`). Pass a non-empty negative prompt to use text-conditioned negative guidance instead. + +## 4. Request examples + +For the complete API, see the [OpenAI-compatible API guide](/docs/sglang-diffusion/api/openai_api). + +```python Example +import base64 + +from openai import OpenAI + +client = OpenAI(api_key="EMPTY", base_url="http://localhost:30000/v1") + +response = client.images.generate( + model="stabilityai/stable-diffusion-xl-base-1.0", + prompt="A beautiful sunset over the ocean, photorealistic", + n=1, + response_format="b64_json", +) + +with open("output.png", "wb") as f: + f.write(base64.b64decode(response.data[0].b64_json)) +``` + +## 5. Benchmark + +Both platforms run the same workload: 1024x1024, 30 steps, guidance scale 7.5, seed 42, and the prompt "a beautiful sunset over the ocean, photorealistic". Each row is one cold `sglang generate` request in a fresh process, not a serving benchmark, so end-to-end time includes one-time startup costs: + +```shell Command +sglang generate --model-path stabilityai/stable-diffusion-xl-base-1.0 \ + --prompt "a beautiful sunset over the ocean, photorealistic" \ + --height 1024 --width 1024 --num-inference-steps 30 --guidance-scale 7.5 --seed 42 \ + --save-output +``` + +The accuracy reference is the Diffusers `StableDiffusionXLPipeline` in full fp32 on the same GPU, started from the same initial latents. The VAE runs in fp32 in every configuration. + + + + - Hardware: Intel Arc Pro B60 (1x, 24GB) + - Software: PyTorch 2.13 (XPU), Diffusers 0.38.0, SGLang built from source + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + +

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Stable Diffusion XL UNet configuration."""
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.configs.models.dits.base import DiTArchConfig, DiTConfig
+
+
+@dataclass
+class StableDiffusionXLUNetArchConfig(DiTArchConfig):
+    """Defaults match stabilityai/stable-diffusion-xl-base-1.0; the loader overwrites
+    them from the checkpoint's unet/config.json."""
+
+    in_channels: int = 4
+    out_channels: int = 4
+    sample_size: int = 128
+    block_out_channels: tuple[int, ...] = (320, 640, 1280)
+    # unet/config.json's `attention_head_dim` holds per-level head counts, while the
+    # runtime reads `attention_head_dim` as the head size; __post_init__ splits them.
+    attention_head_dim: int = 64
+    num_attention_heads_per_level: tuple[int, ...] = (5, 10, 20)
+    cross_attention_dim: int = 2048
+    addition_time_embed_dim: int = 256
+
+    # The native module nests the UNet under `unet.`; Diffusers checkpoints do not.
+    param_names_mapping: dict = field(
+        default_factory=lambda: {r"^(?!unet\.)(.*)$": r"unet.\1"}
+    )
+    reverse_param_names_mapping: dict = field(
+        default_factory=lambda: {r"^unet\.(.*)$": r"\1"}
+    )
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        super().__post_init__()
+        if not isinstance(self.attention_head_dim, int):
+            self.num_attention_heads_per_level = tuple(self.attention_head_dim)
+        self.hidden_size = self.block_out_channels[-1]
+        self.num_attention_heads = self.num_attention_heads_per_level[-1]
+        self.attention_head_dim = self.hidden_size // self.num_attention_heads
+        self.num_channels_latents = self.in_channels
+
+
+@dataclass
+class StableDiffusionXLUNetConfig(DiTConfig):
+    arch_config: StableDiffusionXLUNetArchConfig = field(
+        default_factory=StableDiffusionXLUNetArchConfig
+    )
+    prefix: str = "SDXL"

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Stable Diffusion XL pipeline configuration.
+
+Reuses the SD3 config for CLIP tokenization (no padding mask), penultimate-layer
+CLIP features, spatial latent shape, and VAE weight selection.
+"""
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from typing import Callable
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.configs.models import DiTConfig, EncoderConfig, VAEConfig
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.configs.models.dits.stable_diffusion_xl import (
+    StableDiffusionXLUNetConfig,
+)
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.configs.models.encoders import BaseEncoderOutput
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.configs.models.vaes.stable_diffusion import (
+    StableDiffusionVAEConfig,
+)
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.configs.pipeline_configs.stablediffusion3 import (
+    SD3CLIPTextConfig,
+    StableDiffusion3PipelineConfig,
+    sd3_clip_postprocess_text,
+)
+
+
+@dataclass
+class StableDiffusionXLPipelineConfig(StableDiffusion3PipelineConfig):
+    dit_config: DiTConfig = field(default_factory=StableDiffusionXLUNetConfig)
+    vae_config: VAEConfig = field(default_factory=StableDiffusionVAEConfig)
+
+    # CLIP ViT-L (text_encoder) and OpenCLIP ViT-bigG with projection (text_encoder_2).
+    text_encoder_configs: tuple[EncoderConfig, ...] = field(
+        default_factory=lambda: (SD3CLIPTextConfig(), SD3CLIPTextConfig())
+    )
+    text_encoder_precisions: tuple[str, ...] = field(
+        default_factory=lambda: ("fp16", "fp16")
+    )
+    preprocess_text_funcs: tuple[Callable[[str], str] | None, ...] = field(
+        default_factory=lambda: (None, None)
+    )
+    postprocess_text_funcs: tuple[
+        Callable[[BaseEncoderOutput, dict], torch.Tensor], ...
+    ] = field(
+        default_factory=lambda: (sd3_clip_postprocess_text, sd3_clip_postprocess_text)
+    )
+
+    guidance_scale: float = 5.0
+    # The SDXL VAE overflows in fp16 (force_upcast in vae/config.json).
+    vae_precision: str = "fp32"
+    vae_tiling: bool = False
+    vae_sp: bool = False
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        configs = list(self.text_encoder_configs)
+        configs[0].update_model_arch({"_class_name": "CLIPTextModel"})
+        configs[1].update_model_arch({"_class_name": "CLIPTextModelWithProjection"})
+        self.text_encoder_configs = tuple(configs)
+
+    def get_text_encoder_pooler_output(self, outputs, encoder_index):
+        # SDXL conditions only on the projected pooled output of text_encoder_2.
+        if encoder_index == 1:
+            return outputs.pooler_output
+        return None
+
+    def get_pos_prompt_embeds(self, batch):
+        return torch.cat(batch.prompt_embeds, dim=-1)
+
+    def get_neg_prompt_embeds(self, batch):
+        embeds = torch.cat(batch.negative_prompt_embeds, dim=-1)
+        if self._zero_negative(batch):
+            return torch.zeros_like(embeds)
+        return embeds
+
+    def prepare_pos_cond_kwargs(self, batch, device, rotary_emb, dtype):
+        return self._added_cond_kwargs(batch, text_embeds=batch.pooled_embeds[0])
+
+    def prepare_neg_cond_kwargs(self, batch, device, rotary_emb, dtype):
+        text_embeds = batch.neg_pooled_embeds[0]
+        if self._zero_negative(batch):
+            text_embeds = torch.zeros_like(text_embeds)
+        return self._added_cond_kwargs(batch, text_embeds=text_embeds)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _zero_negative(batch) -> bool:
+        # Diffusers' force_zeros_for_empty_prompt for SDXL base checkpoints.
+        return batch.negative_prompt == ""
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _added_cond_kwargs(batch, *, text_embeds: torch.Tensor) -> dict:
+        # [original_h, original_w, crop_top, crop_left, target_h, target_w]
+        time_ids = torch.tensor(
+            [[batch.height, batch.width, 0, 0, batch.height, batch.width]],
+            device=text_embeds.device,
+            dtype=torch.float32,
+        ).repeat(text_embeds.shape[0], 1)
+        return {"added_cond_kwargs": {"text_embeds": text_embeds, "time_ids": time_ids}}
+
+
+def register():
+    from sglang.multimodal_gen.configs.sample.stable_diffusion_xl import (
+        StableDiffusionXLSamplingParams,
+    )
+    from sglang.multimodal_gen.registry import register_configs
+
+    register_configs(
+        sampling_param_cls=StableDiffusionXLSamplingParams,
+        pipeline_config_cls=StableDiffusionXLPipelineConfig,
+        hf_model_paths=["stabilityai/stable-diffusion-xl-base-1.0"],
+    )

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Stable Diffusion XL UNet: the native SD UNet exposed as a loadable DiT component."""
+
+from typing import Any
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.configs.models.dits.stable_diffusion_xl import (
+    StableDiffusionXLUNetConfig,
+)
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.managers.memory_managers.layerwise_offload import (
+    LayerwiseOffloadableModuleMixin,
+)
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.models.dits.base import CachableDiT
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.models.dits.stable_diffusion import (
+    BasicTransformerBlock,
+    ResnetBlock2D,
+    StableDiffusionUNet2DConditionModel,
+    StableDiffusionUNetConfig,
+)
+
+
+class StableDiffusionXLUNet2DConditionModel(
+    CachableDiT, LayerwiseOffloadableModuleMixin
+):
+    # SDXL checkpoints declare the generic Diffusers UNet class in unet/config.json.
+    _aliases = ["UNet2DConditionModel"]
+    _fsdp_shard_conditions = [
+        lambda n, m: isinstance(m, (BasicTransformerBlock, ResnetBlock2D)),
+    ]
+    _compile_conditions = [
+        lambda n, m: isinstance(m, BasicTransformerBlock),
+    ]
+    param_names_mapping = StableDiffusionXLUNetConfig().arch_config.param_names_mapping
+    reverse_param_names_mapping = (
+        StableDiffusionXLUNetConfig().arch_config.reverse_param_names_mapping
+    )
+    layer_names = ["unet.down_blocks", "unet.up_blocks"]
+    layerwise_offload_dit_group_enabled = True
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        config: StableDiffusionXLUNetConfig,
+        hf_config: dict[str, Any],
+        quant_config=None,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__(config=config, hf_config=hf_config)
+        self.unet = StableDiffusionUNet2DConditionModel(
+            StableDiffusionUNetConfig.from_dict(hf_config)
+        )
+        self.hidden_size = self.config.hidden_size
+        self.num_attention_heads = self.config.num_attention_heads
+        self.num_channels_latents = self.config.num_channels_latents
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        encoder_hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        timestep: torch.Tensor,
+        added_cond_kwargs: dict[str, torch.Tensor],
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return self.unet(
+            hidden_states,
+            timestep,
+            encoder_hidden_states,
+            added_cond_kwargs=added_cond_kwargs,
+            return_dict=False,
+        )[0]
+
+
+EntryClass = StableDiffusionXLUNet2DConditionModel

+#
+# Euler discrete scheduler wrapper for Stable Diffusion XL.
+#
+# Delegates all numerical work to diffusers' implementation and only adapts
+# the interface for sglang's denoising stage.
+
+import torch
+from diffusers import EulerDiscreteScheduler as DiffusersEulerDiscreteScheduler
+from diffusers.configuration_utils import ConfigMixin, register_to_config
+from diffusers.schedulers.scheduling_utils import SchedulerMixin
+
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.models.schedulers.base import BaseScheduler
+
+
+class EulerDiscreteScheduler(SchedulerMixin, ConfigMixin, BaseScheduler):
+    """Euler discrete scheduler wrapper for sglang's BaseScheduler interface."""
+
+    order = 1
+    num_train_timesteps = 1000
+
+    # **kwargs absorbs legacy keys (clip_sample, skip_prk_steps, ...) that SDXL
+    # scheduler configs carry but diffusers' EulerDiscreteScheduler does not take.
+    @register_to_config
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        num_train_timesteps: int = 1000,
+        beta_start: float = 0.0001,
+        beta_end: float = 0.02,
+        beta_schedule: str = "linear",
+        trained_betas=None,
+        prediction_type: str = "epsilon",
+        interpolation_type: str = "linear",
+        use_karras_sigmas: bool = False,
+        use_exponential_sigmas: bool = False,
+        use_beta_sigmas: bool = False,
+        sigma_min: float | None = None,
+        sigma_max: float | None = None,
+        timestep_spacing: str = "linspace",
+        timestep_type: str = "discrete",
+        steps_offset: int = 0,
+        rescale_betas_zero_snr: bool = False,
+        final_sigmas_type: str = "zero",
+        **kwargs,
+    ):
+        self.num_train_timesteps = num_train_timesteps
+        self._inner = DiffusersEulerDiscreteScheduler(
+            num_train_timesteps=num_train_timesteps,
+            beta_start=beta_start,
+            beta_end=beta_end,
+            beta_schedule=beta_schedule,
+            trained_betas=trained_betas,
+            prediction_type=prediction_type,
+            interpolation_type=interpolation_type,
+            use_karras_sigmas=use_karras_sigmas,
+            use_exponential_sigmas=use_exponential_sigmas,
+            use_beta_sigmas=use_beta_sigmas,
+            sigma_min=sigma_min,
+            sigma_max=sigma_max,
+            timestep_spacing=timestep_spacing,
+            timestep_type=timestep_type,
+            steps_offset=steps_offset,
+            rescale_betas_zero_snr=rescale_betas_zero_snr,
+            final_sigmas_type=final_sigmas_type,
+        )
+        self.timesteps = self._inner.timesteps
+        BaseScheduler.__init__(self)
+
+    def set_shift(self, shift: float) -> None:
+        raise ValueError("EulerDiscreteScheduler does not support flow shift.")
+
+    def set_begin_index(self, begin_index: int = 0) -> None:
+        self._inner.set_begin_index(begin_index)
+
+    @property
+    def begin_index(self) -> int | None:
+        return self._inner.begin_index
+
+    def set_timesteps(self, num_inference_steps: int, device=None, **kwargs):
+        self._inner.set_timesteps(num_inference_steps, device=device, **kwargs)
+        self.timesteps = self._inner.timesteps
+
+    def scale_model_input(
+        self, sample: torch.Tensor, timestep: int | None = None
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return self._inner.scale_model_input(sample, timestep)
+
+    def step(
+        self,
+        model_output: torch.Tensor,
+        timestep: float | torch.Tensor,
+        sample: torch.Tensor,
